sources.facts: The parish confirms completion of the existing basilica in 1986 and identifies the modern principal portals.

Architect John Bartlett describes the cruciform mission form, dominant crossing dome, flatter nave and transept volumes. The 1985 article records eight bronze bells cast in Holland and installed in the new tower.
Measured architectural comparison and site inspection identify a dominant cupola, bell tower, central nave and distinct transepts.
The basilica’s approximate crown heights are 85 feet at the principal dome and 104 feet to the tower top.
